question.prompt: Four points \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), and \(D\) lie in that order on line \(l\). How many line segments have these points as endpoints?

solutions.explanation: Every pair of points determines a line segment. There are \(4\times3\div2=6\) in total: \(AB\), \(AC\), \(AD\), \(BC\), \(BD\), and \(CD\).
solutions.title: Count distinct endpoint pairs
